text:
incident-bot: ALERT: billing-metering-service detected token-count delta of 7.8% vs baseline for last 15m in prod-us-west. Signal: token_agg_total. Probing flagged. Pager: @sarah-oncall.

sarah: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Which pipeline?

mike: Looks like emitter->agg window mismatch. Seeing delayed kafka commits around 1689456600. Quick check: run `SELECT bucket, sum(tokens) FROM token_agg WHERE ts > now()-interval '30 minutes' GROUP BY bucket;`

anna: Billing team - watching customer-facing metrics. Any overage flags yet? We have a customer alerting for usage spike.

jordan: Running a quick tail:
```
[2023-07-15T12:30:45Z] emitter commit offset 345678 failed: Timeout
[2023-07-15T12:31:02Z] emitter retry success offset 345678
```
Seems intermittent emitter timeouts.

sarah: Can we force re-ingest for missed window? If safe.

mike: Mitigation plan:
- flip proxy to fallback emitter (route-emitter: fallback)
- restart aggregator pod `kubectl rollout restart deploy/token-agg -n billing`
- temp hold on billing alerts: set `billing.alerts.token-delta` to 10% for 30m

lucy: I've prepared rollout. Applying proxy route now.

ops-bot: oncall-handoff to @mike in 30m. handoff-id: HND-1689456789

anna: Customer impact: a handful of mid-market customers showing duplicate overage flags in dashboard (IDs: C-443, C-778). No invoices generated yet. I'm opening a support snooze for these customers.

jordan: Proxy switch done. Aggregator restart initiated. Logs show aggregator catching up: `processed 1.2M tokens backlog` ETA ~6m.

sarah: Good. Can we confirm usage recon results after backlog drained?

mike: Running reconciliation script:
`/ops/run_recon.sh --from 1689455400 --to 1689456789 --mode=quick`
Prelim diff: 0.5% mismatch, likely due to double counting from retries. Will scrub dup events.

lucy: Deployed patch to emitter to drop duplicate acked messages; will monitor.

anna: Support snooze applied, customers notified: "We are investigating billing deltas; monitoring. No charges will be applied until cleared." :pray: 

jordan: Backlog drained. Aggregator steady. Metrics normalized: token delta now 0.8% over baseline.

sarah: Dropping paging. Leaving temporary alert threshold in place for 1 hour. Thanks all :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: incident closed (INC-1689456789). Postmortem owner: @mike. Please file PM within 48h.
